title: Rolex Started As A London Import Company (Hans Wilsdorf)
hook: The company that became Rolex began as a London import business. Its founder wanted the name to outlast the import trade.
why: Story behind a person who changed watchmaking, with a tension hook in the Dial style. The 1905 London start and the name change are believed accurate but not yet checked. Use an On This Day angle only if a real anniversary is confirmed.

stop_reason: Stopped before build. Facts: the 1905 London firm (Wilsdorf & Davis) and the July 1908 Swiss trademark of Rolex are supported by Britannica and Wikipedia snippets, but sources disagree on the renaming year (1914 vs 1915), so it would need hedged wording. Photos: no rights-cleared photo of Hans Wilsdorf was found. Wikipedia's portrait (Hans_Wilsdorf.jpg) has no stated licence and is credited to Rolex's website, and the Commons results were a bridge named after him and a generic Rolex watch, not story subjects. The story needs a credited, rights-cleared photo for every story slide, so it cannot be built to the rules yet. Next step: find a Commons or permissions.json portrait or period photo of Wilsdorf or the London office, then rerun.
